description: This file contains unit tests for the StringUtil class, verifying various string manipulation methods such as string internment, replacement, joining, splitting, encoding, and truncation.

classes.name: StringUtilTests
classes.description: A JUnit test class that verifies the functionality of StringUtil utility methods.

methods.name: testInternString
methods.description: Tests the internString method for string interning consistency.

methods.name: testReplaceString
methods.description: Tests the replaceString method for correct substring replacements.

methods.name: testJoin
methods.description: Tests the join method for concatenating list elements with a delimiter.

methods.name: testSplit
methods.description: Tests the split method for splitting strings into list elements.

methods.name: testStrToMap
methods.description: Tests converting strings to maps with key-value pairs.

methods.name: testMapToStr
methods.description: Tests converting maps to string representations.

methods.name: testToList
methods.description: Verifies string parsing into list structures.

methods.name: testToSet
methods.description: Verifies string parsing into set structures.

methods.name: testCreateMap
methods.description: Tests the createMap utility for generating maps from key and value lists.

methods.name: testCleanUpPathPrefix
methods.description: Verifies cleaning up of file path prefixes.

methods.name: testRemoveSpaces
methods.description: Checks removal of whitespace characters.

methods.name: testToHexString
methods.description: Validates encoding of byte arrays into hexadecimal strings.

methods.name: testCleanHexString
methods.description: Tests cleaning of hex string formats.

methods.name: testFromHexString
methods.description: Tests decoding hexadecimal strings back into byte arrays.

methods.name: testEncodeInt
methods.description: Verifies integer encoding into character arrays.

methods.name: testRemoveNonNumeric
methods.description: Ensures removal of non-numeric characters from strings.

methods.name: testAddToNumberString
methods.description: Tests arithmetic modifications to numeric strings.

methods.name: testPadNumberString
methods.description: Tests padding numeric strings with leading zeros.

methods.name: testConvertOperatorSubstitutions
methods.description: Verifies replacement of operator placeholders with actual operators.

methods.name: testTruncateString
methods.description: Checks string truncation with encoding and special character handling.
